name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent on every pull request before human review. The 30-60 second delay is a rounding error compared to the hours humans waste on trivial fixes. Trade-off: we accept occasional false positives from PR-Agent to free up human time for high-value review.

name: Gauge
text: PR-Agent’s false positives aren’t the only risk—it also misses context-dependent violations that humans catch, like business logic flaws or team-specific conventions. A better alternative: run PR-Agent *only* on mechanical checks (formatting, linting) and reserve human review for logic and design. Settle it with a controlled experiment: measure false positives and missed issues in PR-Agent-only vs. human-first reviews over 20 PRs.
